svg.text: STAGE 517 · TOPIC 157 · P1027–P1028 🎉 · SVG 161 · 159th FAQ · 🎉 HISTORIC 520th BENCHMARK DIMENSION MILESTONE!
SIP RFC 4916 Connected Identity (from-change) Mid-Call Spoofing & RFC 3325 PAI Spec(T) Guard
⛔ Vulnerable RFC 4916 / 3325 Path (Mid-Call Swap & PAI Spoof)
1. Unauthenticated Mid-Call RFC 4916 From URI Swap
UPDATE (from-change) mutates From: <sip:vip-ceo@bank.com>
• Caller dials in with normal ANI, then swaps From URI mid-call
• Mutating From-tag / To-tag desynchronizes B2BUA dialog state
2. Untrusted Public Trunk P-Asserted-Identity (PAI) Spoofing
Public INVITE + P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:chairman@corp.com>
• Ingress SBC fails to strip PAI outside Spec(T) trust domain
• Downstream AI Voice Agent trusts forged PAI as verified ANI!
3. Unscrubbed Egress PAI Leaking Private Extensions
Egress INVITE (Privacy: id) leaks PAI: <sip:ext-8801@10.0.1.9>
• Violates RFC 3325 §6 requirement to remove PAI on Privacy: id
• Exposes executive direct lines and internal topology to third parties
✅ Deterministic RFC 4916 / 3325 Guardrails (P1027 + P1028 🎉)
P1027 (1,036th Guardrail): Verified from-change & Tag Lock
action: "reject_unauthenticated_from_change_and_lock_dialog_tags"
• Requires cryptographic Identity / Spec(T) auth on From URI change
• clampedUnverifiedMidCallIdentitySwaps = 0 (locks From/To tags)
• clampedMaxConnectedIdentityUpdatesPerCall in [1, 3] updates
Policy: P1027-SIP-RFC4916-CONNECTED-IDENTITY-FROM-CHANGE-AUTHENTICATION-AND-TAG-LOCK-GUARD
P1028 🎉 (Historic 520th Dimension!): Spec(T) PAI & Privacy: id
action: "strip_untrusted_ingress_pai_and_scrub_egress_privacy_id"
• Unconditionally strips PAI / PPI on untrusted non-Spec(T) ingress
• clampedUntrustedPaiPrivilegeEscalations = 0 (zero ANI spoofing)
• Scrubs egress PAI under Privacy: id (unscrubbedEgressPai = 0)
Policy: P1028-SIP-RFC3325-P-ASSERTED-IDENTITY-SPEC-T-BOUNDARY-STRIP-AND-PRIVACY-ID-GUARD
